changes_intro: Three dishes were priced above anything a single vegetarian order fetches in your area. At ₹328, the jeera rice with palak paneer cost more than Khanna's entire non-veg thali at ₹319. This does reduce your rate on these three, and we would rather say so plainly than leave you with three dishes nobody buys.
